jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Health & Life Sciences Market Research (Remote - US-based only)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
  

Escalent is an award\-winning data analytics and advisory firm that helps clients understand human and market behaviors to navigate disruption. As catalysts of progress for more than 40 years, our strategies guide the world’s leading brands. We accelerate growth by creating a seamless flow between primary, secondary, syndicated, and internal business data, providing consulting and advisory services from insights through implementation. Based on a profound understanding of what drives human beings and markets, we identify actions that build brands, enhance customer experiences, inspire product innovation and boost business productivity. We listen, learn, question, discover, innovate, and deliver—for each other and our clients—to make the world work better for people.


**Role Overview**
  

People in our Senior Project Management roles at Escalent lead the projects internally and externally from end to end, driving the logistics and owning any vendor relationships involved in our work, along with providing strategic recommendations to the insights team.


Project Management positions are accountable for making the project work for:


* The Client (communication / on time delivery / quality / problem solving / sound process)
* The Company (Escalent process / financials / budget / margin)
* Our Partners / Vendors

You serve as:


* The one who “keeps the trains on schedule”
* Minder of the Scope, Time, Cost \& Quality
* Strategic lead in sample design, sourcing, and budgeting
* Owner of project status updates to clients
* Coordinator of resources for the project – whether internal or external

Base salary range for this role is $85,000 \- $110,000\. If this is not the right range for you, please check out our other openings. This position is 100% remote.


**Responsibilities**


* You will work closely with colleagues in Insights \& Consulting and Sales \& Strategic Growth on bids and cost estimates for accurate design and pricing of our solutions and bring a project management discipline to delivering our work on\-time, at high quality, within budget and ideally with a healthy margin.
* Upon being awarded the work, you kick off the project with the internal systems and project team.
* You are critical to the Insights \& Consulting roles as well as our Operations teams and Centers of Excellence in communicating timelines and making sure they are ready to support an on\-time, on budget delivery of milestone or final deliverables.
* You will serve as a thinking partner to solve any problems encountered along the way.
* Act as client\-facing lead on all sample and logistics matters
* Responsible for ensuring and supporting project compliance and pharmacovigilance requirements are understood, documented, and executed in accordance with client, internal, and regulatory expectations

**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in business related field required. Advanced degree a plus. A combination of experience and education can be considered in lieu of four\-year degree.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in project management for complex life sciences research projects at a full\-service market research agency
* Proven project management experience (including cost estimating, field management, timeline, compliance and budget management etc.) with a focus on primary market research (both qualitative and quantitative)
* 3\+ years in a client\-facing role, demonstrating excellent client relationship management
* Experience managing market research projects for healthcare, pharma, or life sciences is required
* Advanced proficiency in managing quantitative (online) and qualitative (in \-depth interviews, online focus groups etc.) research methodologies
* Must be able to handle multiple project assignments simultaneously.
* Must have excellent time management skills.
* Must be detail\-orientated, self\-motivated and exhibit high ethical skills.
* Demonstrate excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal) with project teams inside the company and clients outside.
* Able to work effectively within a team\-oriented, highly collaborative environment.
* Understand and speak with confidence in life sciences vernacular as it pertains to audience, therapeutic area, and approach.
* Role is remote, but would prefer working ET hours.

**Compensation, Benefits, and Culture**


* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance \- Large carriers on a national level (domestic partner coverage included)
* 401k with Company Match
* Flexible PTO \- Feel no guilt in taking off a minimum of 3 weeks of “real” vacation time
* Paid Parental leave: 8 weeks
* Paid Sick Leave: up to 8 weeks
* 12 Paid Company Holidays
* Hybrid/Virtual Work \- Virtual\-first workforce with employees in most states
* Base salary range for this role is $85,000 \- $110,000

EEO/AA EMPLOYER M/F/V/D


Equal Opportunity Employer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Lead Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!**

  

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast\-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is now longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high\-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities.

  

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!


**Job Summary**
---------------



The Lead Project Manager will be responsible for directing one or more medium or complex projects through implementation in order to meet the business requirements, customer needs and defined drivers. The Lead Project Manager will ensure successful launch/deployment of various products. This position is the focus to which all processes, communication, accountabilities and procedures are filtered through to ensure an aligned team effort. The key focus of this position is overall management of projects across multiple business groups and ensuring delivery of specific business/customer functionality that is on\-time and on\-budget.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Directly responsible for managing and overseeing project: scope, cost, schedule, risk, human resources, communications, procurement, change and methods for measuring results.
* Coordinates IT and non\-IT resources to consistently deliver high quality products and services on\-time and within budget.
* Develops timetables for implementation, monitors and performs strategic analysis for the project.
* Serves as a liaison with company resources and systems to provide current data and information needed.
* Researches and makes recommendations on procedures to enhance financial and operational efficiencies.
* Tracks expenses and provides detailed updates to appropriate managers on project status
* Partners to develop/deliver communications regarding the progress, accountabilities and gaps in the progress of assigned projects
* Researches, compiles and reports current data and manages teams through launch process.
* Assembles and coordinates project team members; assigns individual responsibilities.
* Prepares requests for proposals and conducts all necessary meetings to facilitate selection of project services/products.
* Knowledge of the techniques for managing cross\-functional teams.
* Skilled in planning and preparing effective written communications.
* Skilled in presenting ideas and concepts
* Ability to synthesize project information and establish the appropriate scope of a project.
* Ability to apply strong project management skills and methodologies.
* Ability to collaborate, communicate and manage team members at all levels effectively.
**Qualifications**
------------------


* A Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or related discipline; or equivalent related work experience
* Current Project Management Professional certification (PMP) preferred
* Minimum 7\+ years of project management responsibility, demonstrating leadership skills and managing technical and non\-technical resources through various life\-cycle phases (cross functional experience preferred)
* Extensive knowledge of Microsoft Office and Project (or Smartsheets)
* Experience with Executive presentation skills to draft professional, formal briefing material.
* Highly developed interpersonal, written and verbal communications
* Uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret data analyses for operational insights. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.
* Collaborates with key stakeholders outside own area of expertise
* Consistent record of accomplishing short term business objectives
* Ability to work independently and with others at all levels within the organization
* Ability to organize and prioritize effectively
* Demonstrated facilitation skills and ability to manage meetings with project team members
* Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel
* Formal project management training/certification required; Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent
* Use of formal software development lifecycle methodologies; such as Waterfall or Agile
* Strong understanding of cable industry, digital solutions or customer experience
* Knowledge of customer care operations, agent support (desktop tools, voice/screen recordings) or customer channels (e.g. SMS, Messaging, Chatbots, IVR, and surveys) a plus


At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. These aren’t just words, they help us build trust, create real community, and embrace new ways of thinking. Our employees are empowered to do the right thing for our customers and co\-workers and to recognize and reward these behaviors when we see them. It’s all part of the bigger picture of “Be The Difference” where each employee knows they have the power to enact real change, share new ideas, and understand that learning never stops.

  

If you have the drive to succeed and are ready to embark on a thrilling career, seize this opportunity today, and join our winning team. Together, we'll shape the future of connectivity.

jobs.title: Program Operations Analyst, National Security Space
jobs.description:
**Description**  

Do you enjoy working as part of a team while orchestrating business, program, and logistical solutions to enable some of the Nation's most interesting technology research?  

Do you enjoy working on challenging projects in a dynamic work environment?  

Do you have the ability to work on a broad range of tasks ranging from assisting with program management to financial analysis to processing expense reports in highly classified environments?  

Do you possess strong interpersonal, problem\-solving, and teaming skill sets?  

If so, we’re looking for someone like you to join our team at Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (JHU/APL)!  

As the Program Operations Analyst in the National Security Space Mission Area in the Space Exploration Sector (SES), you will oversee and manage daily activities and operations for the mission area in Laurel, Maryland with reach back to Colorado Springs, Colorado. You will ensure seamless execution of tactical implementation, facilitate the success of existing tasks, support new business initiatives, complete data transfers on classified networks, and address mission area level requirements with operational and administrative coordination. You would be joining a dedicated team of program managers and other Program Operations Analysts who are tackling the biggest national security challenges we face today. We are passionate about the work we do and we strive to deliver high\-quality and timely products to our Government sponsors. We aim to foster a highly collaborative, fulfilling, and fun work environment. **As a Program Operations Analyst you will…**  

* Program and Project Operations – Directly report to the Program Area Manager and work in conjunction with the Program Managers and Project Managers to set priorities, and resolve issues for the overall task management needs \- from project initiation to project closure. Develops standard operating procedures (SOP) to ensure project deadlines are met and sponsor requirements are satisfied.
* Program and Project Administration – Thorough understanding of or the ability to quickly learn about the project or product being developed. Prepare and organize information for internal and external program and project reviews, including content review of technical materials prepared by technical staff. Plan, organize, and facilitate meetings and conferences/seminars for both internal and external participants and sponsors. Interface with sponsors and their representatives to collect presentation information, ensure clearances are prepared, manage scheduling, reservations and all other logistics. Attend meetings and deduce requirements and note action items.
* Logistics and Collaboration – Work with other APL organizations (i.e., security, finance, communications, contracts, IT, etc.) to organize various levels of support and ensure successful execution. Extrapolate contractual deliverables from the contract or task, to be part of the task plan and monitor progress of the program against those deliverables. Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Program Finances \& Staffing Plans – Collaborate with the Financial Manager (FM) in monitoring the financial status of the program if required. Analyze and detect potential deviations in project plans based on the latest information available.
* Proposal Development – Facilitate and manage the proposal development timeline in conjunction with the Financial Manager. Gather technical inputs and applicable technical review and recommend content to include in final submission. Responsible for the overall quality of the final submission.
* Technical Support, Analysis, and Reporting – Develop an understanding of the technical work being performed by the program and be able to adequately convey the methodology, impact, and importance to others. Collaborate with PM on 30\-day kickoff Review and impactful updates to the task plan. Assist in the development of the Statement of Work (SOW) and ensure adherence to the SOW through collaboration with the PM and technical teams. In collaboration with the PMs, PjMs, and Chief Engineers, prepare and maintain technical status reports, briefings, schedules, and summaries.
* Security, Facility, and Data Management – Maintain a thorough understanding of security policies governing classified information handling, marking, storage, transmission, and facility operations. Maintain security\-related documentation, repositories, and operational procedures. Coordinate facility maintenance, hardware upgrades, inventory management, and operational support activities for classified technical facilities. Collaborate on the procurement, tracking, and maintenance of technical equipment, including preparing and submitting requisitions for material purchases as needed. Serve as a Data Transfer Agent for classified networks and conduct data transfers as required to meet program needs.
* Travel \& work arrangement – Travel in support of the Program Area Manager and Program Managers on an as\-needed basis to support sponsor visits and logistics. The work arrangement will be fully on\-site and in the office.


  

**Qualifications** **You meet the qualifications for the job if you…*** Have a Bachelor’s degree in a business administration, organizational leadership, technical, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Have five (5\) years of work\-related experience, or eight (8\) years of direct relevant work\-related experience in lieu of a Bachelor’s degree.
* Have a demonstrated proficiency in the analysis and evaluation of program / project milestones, schedules, contractual deliverables, and financial management
* Are a high\-performer and self\-starter with extensive knowledge of administrative processes and programmatic processes
* Have a strong sense of urgency, adaptability, resourcefulness, and flexibility
* Have the ability to work multiple projects simultane

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Business Technology Integrators (BTI) is a Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) with more than 25 years of experience delivering innovative and reliable IT and engineering solutions to the Federal Government. BTI supports mission\-critical programs across defense and civilian agencies, with core expertise in cybersecurity, program management, enterprise IT, and technical oversight services.  

  

BTI is currently searching for a Business Analyst to fulfill the roles and responsibilities below:  

  

**Roles and** **Responsibilities:**  

  

The Business Analyst is responsible for eliciting, analyzing, documenting, and validating functional and non\-functional requirements for the EFAST2 system across the full lifecycle of the modernization effort from initial Transition\-In discovery through Core Development, Integration, Go\-Live, Hypercare, and into steady\-state Operations \& Maintenance.  

  

This role leads discovery activities during Transition\-In, including structured knowledge\-transfer sessions with the incumbent O\&M vendor, to capture existing system functionality, clarify ambiguous or undocumented requirements, and identify gaps between current capabilities and Government objectives, and works closely with the Project Manager, Technical Lead, UI/UX Specialist, and Product Owner to build and continuously refine the product backlog so that user stories are prioritized by business value and technical dependency and contain complete, testable acceptance criteria.  

  

The Business Analyst reviews wireframes and UX mockups developed by the UI/UX Specialist against documented requirements to confirm alignment prior to Product Owner approval, and remains actively engaged throughout each sprint to validate that delivered functionality satisfies the documented business requirements and acceptance criteria prior to story completion, reviewing developed features against the original requirement intent, participating in sprint reviews and UAT sessions to confirm correct implementation of business rules and DER/edit\-test logic, and identifying and reporting discrepancies between delivered functionality and specified requirements.  

  

The Business Analyst maintains end\-to\-end requirements traceability (Roadmap User Stories Tasks Test Results) across all annual rollover cycles, ensuring that as the system evolves — through new epics, annual forms changes, and post\-go\-live enhancements — validated requirements remain accurate and any implementation drift is caught and corrected, and serves as the ongoing liaison between EBSA/OCIO business stakeholders and the technical development team for the life of the contract.  

  

**Experience/Qualifications:*** Undergraduate college degree from an accredited college or university in business administration, information systems, computer science, or related discipline, or equivalent experience
* At least 6 years of experience performing business analysis, requirements gathering, and documentation for IT application development projects
* At least 3 years of experience working within an Agile/Scrum environment, writing and refining user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria
* Experience validating delivered functionality against documented business requirements and acceptance criteria, including UAT support and sprint review participation, prior to Government sign\-off
* Experience conducting stakeholder meetings, facilitating requirements workshops, and leading knowledge\-transfer or discovery sessions with incumbent contractors or legacy system owners
* Experience translating business and regulatory requirements (e.g., ERISA, Form 5500 series filing requirements) into functional specifications and system design inputs
* Experience with Jira for requirements traceability and backlog management, and with Confluence and Microsoft SharePoint for organizing project documentation and requirements artifacts
* Experience reviewing wireframes and UX mockups against documented requirements to confirm alignment prior to Product Owner approval
* Working knowledge of federal IT development processes, including Section 508 accessibility requirements and information security considerations.
* Experience supporting annual system change cycles, including analyzing legislative or regulatory changes for system impact and validating that rollover implementations match specified requirements

jobs.title: NetSuite Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence

**About the Team**


Crowe’s NetSuite consulting practice helps organizations transform their finance and operational systems through the implementation and optimization of Oracle NetSuite ERP, a leading cloud\-based enterprise resource planning platform. Our team works with clients across a range of industries to design, implement, and support scalable ERP solutions that improve financial visibility, streamline operations, and enable data\-driven decision\-making.


Our professionals combine deep accounting and operational expertise with technical NetSuite capabilities—including financial modules, workflows, reporting, integrations, and automation—to deliver end\-to\-end implementations and process improvements. As part of our growing consulting practice, you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that help organizations modernize their finance functions and support long\-term growth.

**About the Role**


Crowe seeks a **NetSuite Implementation Manager** to lead ERP implementations for Manufacturing and Distribution clients. This role oversees project delivery, manages client relationships, and leads consulting teams throughout implementation engagements. You will guide the full implementation lifecycle including discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support.


The ideal candidate combines ERP consulting experience with NetSuite functional knowledge and supply chain expertise. Experience supporting manufacturing operations, inventory management, supply chain, and order management processes is highly valued.


This role requires managing multiple projects while mentoring consultants and ensuring strong client outcomes. You will partner with client leaders across finance, operations, supply chain, warehouse, and production teams. Together, you will design scalable NetSuite solutions that improve operational efficiency and inventory visibility.


This position is comparable to roles such as NetSuite Project Manager or NetSuite ERP Consulting Manager.

**Core Skills**


NetSuite ERP, ERP Implementation, NetSuite Financials, Manufacturing ERP, Supply Chain ERP, SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteAnalytics, NetSuite Advanced Manufacturing, NetSuite Advanced Inventory, NetSuite Demand Planning, NetSuite Order Management, NetSuite WMS, ERP Consulting, Financial Systems Implementation, NetSuite Integrations, Business Process Transformation, ERP Project Management

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead NetSuite ERP implementations in several industries (with an emphasis on Manufacturing and Distribution) from discovery through post\-go\-live support.
* Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, and deliverables while ensuring successful client outcomes.
* Gather and document business requirements related business processes.
* Facilitate requirements workshops, solution design discussions, and user acceptance testing sessions.
* Configure NetSuite modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, and multi\-entity financial consolidations.
* Implement operational modules including Procurement, Order Management, Inventory, Demand Planning, and Manufacturing; with working knowledge of project\-based or subscription billing for services clients.
* Support manufacturing processes including bill of materials, work orders, production planning, and shop floor operations.
* Configure workflows and reporting using SuiteFlow, SuiteAnalytics, and other NetSuite platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with technical teams implementing integrations with WMS, ecommerce, logistics, and supply chain systems.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through process optimization and automation.
* Mentor consultants and analysts while supporting knowledge sharing across implementation teams.
* Ensure successful client transition to post\-implementation support or managed services tea

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Liquidité & Finance Réglementaire - F/H
jobs.description:
Descriptif de la société
  

  

INGENIANCE est une ESN spécialisée en finance de marché, banque et assurance depuis plus de 18 ans. Nous accompagnons les grands acteurs bancaires et assurantiels français sur leurs projets les plus critiques, avec une expertise reconnue en Craft Development, Big Data, Cloud/DevOps et Agilité. Rejoindre Ingéniance, c'est intégrer une communauté d'experts, être accompagné par un management de proximité et construire son parcours sur des missions à forte valeur ajoutée. Build your success!
  

  

Contexte de la mission
  

  

Nous recherchons pour une mission longue chez notre client secteur banque/finance en région parisienne un Business Analyst confirmé, spécialisé en finance réglementaire et en solutions de liquidité.
  

  

Vous intégrez une équipe dédiée aux solutions de liquidité, au sein d'une direction IT transversale de grande banque internationale. Vos missions couvrent l'analyse fonctionnelle et le pilotage de sujets à fort enjeu réglementaire :
* Analyser les besoins métier liés aux opérations de financement international et aux exigences réglementaires applicables à la liquidité
* Traduire ces besoins en spécifications fonctionnelles détaillées à destination des équipes IT
* Piloter et coordonner les chantiers IT en lien avec les parties prenantes métier, MOE et éditeurs
* Assurer le suivi des évolutions des plateformes finance utilisées par les équipes (paramétrages, recettes, déploiements)
* Contribuer aux travaux de reporting financier et réglementaire : cadrage, contrôle de cohérence, validation des livrables
* Analyser et qualifier les impacts des évolutions réglementaires sur les processus et les outils de la direction
* Rédiger les comptes rendus, supports de comités et documents de suivi de projet
* Être l'interlocuteur de référence entre les équipes métier et IT sur le périmètre liquidité

Profil recherché
  

  

Formation Bac\+5 (école d'ingénieurs, école de commerce ou université) en finance, informatique ou équivalent. Expérience confirmée (5 ans minimum) en Business Analyse ou IT Project Management dans un environnement bancaire ou financier exigeant.
  

  

Compétences techniques et fonctionnelles attendues au niveau expert :
* Réglementation sur les transactions financières internationales (financement structuré, liquidité)
* Finance structurée et instruments associés
* Comptabilité financière et reporting réglementaire
* Connaissance des plateformes finance et outils de gestion de la liquidité
* Capacités d'analyse et de synthèse avancées

Anglais professionnel requis pour évoluer dans un environnement international. Rigueur, autonomie et sens de la communication sont des atouts déterminants pour réussir dans ce rôle.
  

  

Informations complémentaires
  

  

Conformément à la réglementation, et à notre politique d'égalité professionnelle, tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

jobs.description:

Build your success!
  

  

Contexte de la mission
  

  

Nous recherchons pour une mission longue chez notre client secteur banque/finance en région parisienne un Business Analyst / IT Project Manager confirmé (MOA Niveau 3\) intervenant sur des applications centrales de booking en temps réel, couvrant les produits Equity Derivatives et Complex Rates.
  

  

Vous rejoignez une équipe d'une trentaine de personnes organisée en pôles d'expertise (analyse, développement, support) et travaillez en cycles courts Scrum/Agile sur un système en intégration forte avec l'ensemble du système d'information, à portée internationale (Europe, Asie, Amérique du Nord).
  

  

Vos missions principales :
* Recueillir les besoins métier et rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles détaillées
* Élaborer les estimations de coøts et contribuer au cadrage des sujets
* Rédiger les tests de non\-régression et piloter les phases UAT jusqu'à la validation client
* Participer aux développements en approche Test Driven Development (TDD)
* Assurer le support fonctionnel auprès des équipes Front, Middle et Back Office
* Gérer le cycle de vie des produits listés : gestion des positions, expiration, OST, émissions
* Veiller au respect des contraintes réglementaires (droits d'accès, audit des opérations)
* Assurer un reporting régulier de l'avancement et remonter les alertes si nécessaire

Profil recherché
  

  

Formation Bac\+5 (école d'ingénieurs, école de commerce ou université) en informatique, mathématiques ou finance. Expérience de 5 ans minimum en Business Analyse / MOA sur des applications de marchés financiers, idéalement dans le domaine des produits dérivés actions ou de taux. Maîtrise indispensable de XML et SQL. Bonne connaissance des processus de booking et des flux STP (Front\-to\-Back). Expérience en méthodologie Agile/Scrum appréciée. Anglais professionnel requis pour les échanges avec les équipes internationales. Capacité d'analyse et de synthèse, rigueur, prise d'initiative et sens du collectif sont attendus.

Our professionals combine deep accounting and operational expertise with technical NetSuite capabilities—including financial modules, workflows, reporting, integrations, and automation—to deliver end\-to\-end implementations and process improvements. As part of our growing consulting practice, you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that help organizations modernize their finance functions and support long\-term growth.

**About the Role**


Crowe seeks a **NetSuite Implementation Manager** to lead ERP implementations for Manufacturing and Distribution clients. This role oversees project delivery, manages client relationships, and leads consulting teams throughout implementation engagements. You will guide the full implementation lifecycle including discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support.


The ideal candidate combines ERP consulting experience with NetSuite functional knowledge and supply chain expertise. Experience supporting manufacturing operations, inventory management, supply chain, and order management processes is highly valued.


This role requires managing multiple projects while mentoring consultants and ensuring strong client outcomes. You will partner with client leaders across finance, operations, supply chain, warehouse, and production teams. Together, you will design scalable NetSuite solutions that improve operational efficiency and inventory visibility.


This position is comparable to roles such as NetSuite Project Manager or NetSuite ERP Consulting Manager.

**Core Skills**


NetSuite ERP, ERP Implementation, NetSuite Financials, Manufacturing ERP, Supply Chain ERP, SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteAnalytics, NetSuite Advanced Manufacturing, NetSuite Advanced Inventory, NetSuite Demand Planning, NetSuite Order Management, NetSuite WMS, ERP Consulting, Financial Systems Implementation, NetSuite Integrations, Business Process Transformation, ERP Project Management

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead NetSuite ERP implementations in several industries (with an emphasis on Manufacturing and Distribution) from discovery through post\-go\-live support.
* Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, and deliverables while ensuring successful client outcomes.
* Gather and document business requirements related business processes.
* Facilitate requirements workshops, solution design discussions, and user acceptance testing sessions.
* Configure NetSuite modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, and multi\-entity financial consolidations.
* Implement operational modules including Procurement, Order Management, Inventory, Demand Planning, and Manufacturing; with working knowledge of project\-based or subscription billing for services clients.
* Support manufacturing processes including bill of materials, work orders, production planning, and shop floor operations.
* Configure workflows and reporting using SuiteFlow, SuiteAnalytics, and other NetSuite platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with technical teams implementing integrations with WMS, ecommerce, logistics, and supply chain systems.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through process optimization and automation.
* Mentor consultants and analysts while supporting knowledge sharing across implementation teams.
* Ensure successful client transition to post\-implementation support or managed services tea

People in our Senior Project Management roles at Escalent lead the projects internally and externally from end to end, driving the logistics and owning any vendor relationships involved in our work, along with providing strategic recommendations to the insights team.


Project Management positions are accountable for making the project work for:

new_jobs.title: Lead Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!**

  

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast\-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is now longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high\-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities.

  

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!


**Job Summary**
---------------



The Lead Project Manager will be responsible for directing one or more medium or complex projects through implementation in order to meet the business requirements, customer needs and defined drivers. The Lead Project Manager will ensure successful launch/deployment of various products. This position is the focus to which all processes, communication, accountabilities and procedures are filtered through to ensure an aligned team effort. The key focus of this position is overall management of projects across multiple business groups and ensuring delivery of specific business/customer functionality that is on\-time and on\-budget.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Directly responsible for managing and overseeing project: scope, cost, schedule, risk, human resources, communications, procurement, change and methods for measuring results.
* Coordinates IT and non\-IT resources to consistently deliver high quality products and services on\-time and within budget.
* Develops timetables for implementation, monitors and performs strategic analysis for the project.
* Serves as a liaison with company resources and systems to provide current data and information needed.
* Researches and makes recommendations on procedures to enhance financial and operational efficiencies.
* Tracks expenses and provides detailed updates to appropriate managers on project status
* Partners to develop/deliver communications regarding the progress, accountabilities and gaps in the progress of assigned projects
* Researches, compiles and reports current data and manages teams through launch process.
* Assembles and coordinates project team members; assigns individual responsibilities.
* Prepares requests for proposals and conducts all necessary meetings to facilitate selection of project services/products.
* Knowledge of the techniques for managing cross\-functional teams.
* Skilled in planning and preparing effective written communications.
* Skilled in presenting ideas and concepts
* Ability to synthesize project information and establish the appropriate scope of a project.
* Ability to apply strong project management skills and methodologies.
* Ability to collaborate, communicate and manage team members at all levels effectively.
**Qualifications**
------------------


* A Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or related discipline; or equivalent related work experience
* Current Project Management Professional certification (PMP) preferred
* Minimum 7\+ years of project management responsibility, demonstrating leadership skills and managing technical and non\-technical resources through various life\-cycle phases (cross functional experience preferred)
* Extensive knowledge of Microsoft Office and Project (or Smartsheets)
* Experience with Executive presentation skills to draft professional, formal briefing material.
* Highly developed interpersonal, written and verbal communications
* Uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret data analyses for operational insights. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.
* Collaborates with key stakeholders outside own area of expertise
* Consistent record of accomplishing short term business objectives
* Ability to work independently and with others at all levels within the organization
* Ability to organize and prioritize effectively
* Demonstrated facilitation skills and ability to manage meetings with project team members
* Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel
* Formal project management training/certification required; Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent
* Use of formal software development lifecycle methodologies; such as Waterfall or Agile
* Strong understanding of cable industry, digital solutions or customer experience
* Knowledge of customer care operations, agent support (desktop tools, voice/screen recordings) or customer channels (e.g. SMS, Messaging, Chatbots, IVR, and surveys) a plus


At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. These aren’t just words, they help us build trust, create real community, and embrace new ways of thinking. Our employees are empowered to do the right thing for our customers and co\-workers and to recognize and reward these behaviors when we see them. It’s all part of the bigger picture of “Be The Difference” where each employee knows they have the power to enact real change, share new ideas, and understand that learning never stops.

  

If you have the drive to succeed and are ready to embark on a thrilling career, seize this opportunity today, and join our winning team. Together, we'll shape the future of connectivity.
